# Rotary Club of Choba-Uniport — 16th Installation Ceremony

> Official site for the 16th Installation Ceremony of the Rotary Club of Choba-Uniport, District 9141, Nigeria. Friday, 3rd July 2026 at Helena Haven Hotel.

## Pages
- [Home](/): Event overview, leadership, awards, goodwill messages.
- [Register](/register): Reserve a seat across Standard, Premium and VIP tiers.
- [Sponsor](/sponsor): Sponsorship packages and enquiry form.
- [Raffle](/raffle): Buy raffle tickets supporting club service projects.
- [My slip](/receipt): Look up your entry slip by reference or phone.
